documents.content: A callback FAILED with actual receiver HTTP 503 is a transport failure. ACKNOWLEDGED with HTTP 202 means only accepted into the receiver queue. Verify the same event receiver processing state; QUEUED is not PROCESSED. Never resend automatically.
documents.query: async order HTTP 200 downstream callback not received delivery acknowledgement receiver processing
documents.title: Callback acknowledgement and receiver processing

result.reason: User asked to check the active integration contract first; the key unknown is whether a callback is due and what delivery vs receiver-processing states mean.

args.query: async order HTTP 200 downstream callback not received delivery acknowledgement receiver processing
args.reason: User asked to check the active integration contract first; the key unknown is whether a callback is due and what delivery vs receiver-processing states mean.

model_traces.assistant_text: 我先核实当前订单的生命周期事实，因为“接口 200”并不等于订单已进入应触发回调的完成状态。

args.reason: 需要确认绑定订单的当前生命周期状态，判断异步回调是否已到期/应触发；这是区分“回调尚未到期”与“回调丢失”的前提。订单 GET 曾返回 200 不足以证明订单完成。
Order GET shows COMPLETED, which does not prove callback delivery. I need the current bound callback event and actual transport acknowledgement/failure before assessing receiver processing.
订单已 COMPLETED，投递仅为 ACKNOWLEDGED（接收端 HTTP 202，只代表已入接收队列）。当前缺少同一 event 的接收端实际处理状态，需核实是否 QUEUED 或 PROCESSED，以判断下游“没收到”是传输、排队还是业务处理问题。
